card.line: Horesh was a place in the Wilderness of Ziph where David hid from King Saul, and where Jonathan encouraged him.

moments.title: Jonathan strengthens David
moments.text: David saw that Saul had come out to take his life. Jonathan came to David in Horesh and strengthened his hand in God, telling him not to be afraid because he would be king.

moments.title: A covenant before the LORD
moments.text: David and Jonathan made a covenant before the LORD. Then Jonathan went home, and David stayed in Horesh.

moments.title: The Ziphites tell Saul
moments.text: The Ziphites went to Saul at Gibeah and told him David was hiding in the strongholds at Horesh. They offered to deliver David into the king's hand.
